Notable Accomplishments

Internationally renowned medical doctor of public health

Recipient of many internationally prestigious medical awards and prizes

Spent 14 years in Taiwan working on prevention and eradication of Hepatitis B, saving millions of lives (1972-1986)

Dean of the Health Science Center at Houston School of Public Health, University of Texas (1987-2004)

Married Taiwanese American female medical doctor Lu-Yu Hwang (黃綠玉)

Outstanding Taiwanese American elected by T.A. Archives, February 2010
